readme: # Wallet Tweaks UI tweaks for Google Wallet ## Features: - Display passes in 2-3 columns - Hide pass icons or scale them down - Show only pass titles - All pass texts in a single line - Scale down pass texts ## Known issues: To avoid sorting issues, use a single-column layout. ## Support/Discussion URL [xda](https://forum.xda-developers.com/t/mod-xposed-4-1-updatelocker-stop-update-your-apps.4433253/) or [4pda](https://4pda.to/forum/index.php?s=&showtopic=603033&view=findpost&p=114402375) ## Author [MikeZh](https://4pda.to/forum/index.php?showuser=683427), 2025
